title: Cloud data-plane (data-event) logging opt-in configuration
event_type: Cloud provider console — data-plane/data-event logging configuration screen (e.g., AWS CloudTrail S3 data-events selector)

callouts.explanation: This tier is enabled by default and is what most teams mean when they say 'we have CloudTrail' — it only covers configuration/API-control-plane actions, not access to the data itself.

This is the separate, explicit opt-in tier that must be turned on per-resource to see actual object/record access (e.g., S3 GetObject); left disabled, a mass-download event against a bucket the attacker already has read access to produces zero log entries.
Even when the data-events tier is enabled, it must be scoped to specific buckets/resources — an org can enable the feature but still have zero coverage if no resources are selected here.

note: Illustrative/conceptual mockup of a cloud console logging-configuration screen; not a captured screenshot of any real vendor product.
